definitions.explanation: An aromatic or pungent substance used to flavor food. Also used figuratively to mean something that adds interest or excitement.

examples.japanese: ⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧スパイス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧スパイス⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This spice has a nice aroma.

examples.japanese: スパイス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何種類|なんしゅるい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made an authentic curry using many different spices.

notes:
USAGE:
スパイス refers to dry seasonings and aromatics (cumin, turmeric, pepper, etc.), as distinct from ⟦{調味料|ちょうみりょう}→調味料：04941_choumiryou⟧ (seasonings in general, including soy sauce, salt, etc.). スパイス⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧ (spice curry) is a popular genre of curry in Japan that emphasizes individual spices over pre-made roux.

The figurative use (something that adds excitement to life) mirrors the English metaphor: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スパイス (the spice of life).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スパイス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{効|き}かせる→効く：01932_kiku⟧: to season well with spices
- スパイス⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧: spice curry
- ⟦{香辛料|こうしんりょう}→香辛料：04943_koushinryou⟧: spices (more formal synonym)
- スパイス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: the aroma of spices
